::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2020 (registered in Kanhangad, Kasaragod; R&D team in Kochi) by Rijin John and Dr Arun Ashok. Taped out its SC2391 GNSS/5G front-end module in August 2022; ₹7.59 crore government grant (credited to C-DOT on its site, DoT TTDF by DigiTimes). IESA Technovision 2022 'Most Promising Start-Up'.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Analog/RF/mixed-signal hard IP and RF front-end modules for GNSS, 5G and Ka-band LEO satellite communications.
